other_conditions: Girl child must be born on or after January 1, 2006
Girl child must be registered in the local Anganwadi centre
Parents must be natives of Madhya Pradesh
Parents should not be income taxpayers
Family planning must be adopted after the birth of the second child for eligibility of the second girl child
The first girl child (from the first delivery) is eligible without family planning, but family planning is required for a second girl child
In special cases where one parent is deceased, registration can be done until the girl child is 5 years old
If a widowed parent remarries and already has two children, a girl born from the second marriage is not eligible
All three girls born together in the first delivery are eligible
Girls born to women prisoners are eligible
Girl child born to a rape victim is eligible
The collector may extend approval period to two years where family planning is not adopted due to health reasons
Orphanage or protection home applications must be made within one year of admission and before the girl turns 5, or within one year of adoption
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a total benefit of up to ₹1,43,000 per girl, including annual deposits, education incentives, and a final payment of ₹1,00,000 upon completion of education, age 21, or marriage.
